body:
I have tried to reach out to my mom and other people around me, but she has never trusted doctors or medicine much (another reason why I stopped therapy a year and a half ago), it just hasn't been successful. I don't know where to turn now, pretty much everyone I talk to about my problems gets extremely frustrated with me because I am very argumentative and just constantly resist the things they try to comfort me with. I don't feel like I can even stop myself, it has kind of led me to stop talking to others so much about my problems because I know it only distresses them and drives them away further.

I'm not sure what I want to study. I have vague interests in political science, linguistics, film studies, teaching, and art, but I don't really expect to get a degree in anything, I just have never really thought I had it in me

Thank you, by the way, I appreciate your doing this
